target.statement: AUC-ROC of 0.9996 and AUC-PR of 0.9728 for PFLiForest at point E (max_depth=6, num_trees=25, training_data=200) with ~153 kB training memory
target.dataset: Synthetic temperature dataset (real-world sensor temperature values + Gaussian noise, 10% injected anomalies, 10000 test values)

compute.basis: No code or data released; the PFLiForest algorithm (Algorithms 1-4) and the PTB-FLA federated framework would have to be reimplemented from scratch, then 40 repetitions x 5 forest sizes x 5 depths x 4 data sizes of federated tree building run on tiny data (<=200 training points, 10000 test points) — all CPU-only and small, but the reimplementation and debugging dominate.

blockers: No code repository linked in the paper
Training temperature data not provided (only described as real-world sensor readings)
Requires reimplementing the PTB-FLA federated learning testbed and the FLiForest layer-by-layer aggregation protocol from the paper's pseudocode
Exact synthetic test-data generation (noise level, anomaly injection) not fully specified, so exact numbers may not match
title: Federated Isolation Forest for Efficient Anomaly Detection on Edge IoT Systems
